claims: As of March 2026, NASA's Artemis IV mission is scheduled to launch in 2028.
As of March 2026, NASA's Artemis IV mission is specifically targeted for September 2028.
NASA's Artemis IV mission will utilize the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
NASA's Artemis IV mission will deliver the European Space Agency's (ESA) International Habitat (I-Hab) module to the Gateway lunar station.
The mission goal of Artemis IV is to deliver the I-Hab module to the Lunar Gateway.
The mission goal of Artemis IV is to land astronauts on the Moon.
Artemis IV is launching from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Pad 39B in Florida.
Crew members for Artemis IV are not yet finalized.
Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby scheduled for 2026.
Artemis III is a planned lunar landing scheduled for 2027.
Artemis IV follows Artemis II and Artemis III.
